findings.evidence: Claude Code nests (a subagent may spawn subagents, three layers by default); opencode's default nesting depth is one and pi has no built-in subagents
findings.fix: Keep only the action: nest the analyzer where the host allows it, otherwise run it inline and say so. Drop the per-host nesting facts the harness already provides.

findings.evidence: A phase the script lists as skipped (executed or complete) under an explicit request runs only after the user confirms it.
findings.fix: State the order: when the script lists a requested phase as skipped, ask the confirmation before the single range question, then continue with the confirmed set.

findings.evidence: One real run scored the same item 0.74, then 0.67.
findings.fix: Move this into the jev non-determinism rule in section 3 and name the action it requires; delete the Evidence heading.

findings.evidence: Chains GSD /gsd-spec-phase then /gsd-discuss-phase over a range of phases (SPEC.md, then CONTEXT.md + DISCUSSION-LOG.md). Use when asked to spec and discuss several GSD phases unattended or in one run
findings.fix: Chain GSD /gsd-spec-phase then /gsd-discuss-phase over a range of phases, writing NN-SPEC.md then NN-CONTEXT.md and NN-DISCUSSION-LOG.md. Use when asked to spec and discuss several GSD phases unattended or in one run ("spec/discuss phases 17-24", "run spec-phase and discuss-phase for every undiscussed phase", "--analyze --all --batch --assumptions"), or to use jev for GSD planning decisions, even when the user says only "finish the undiscussed phases". Settles gray areas with advisory answers from the `jev-fast-decision` skill, with logged decisions, a deferred ledger, cross-phase amendments and a best-over-easy design rule. Two run modes, picked once: auto or interactive. Works without `jev-fast-decision` installed. Not for plan-phase, execute-phase, or writing one SPEC or CONTEXT by hand.

findings.evidence: Claude Code: a subagent may spawn subagents (three layers by default); the orchestrator resumes it with `SendMessage` to its id or name.
findings.fix: Delete the host-capability restatement. Keep the resume action and the inline fallback, which SKILL.md already gates.

findings.evidence: opencode documents continuing a child by its `sessionID`, unverified here
findings.fix: Give one default: resume the same subagent with the host's documented continuation call; if that call is unavailable or unverified for this host, run the phase inline and say so. Do not leave the agent to choose between an unverified call and the fallback.

findings.evidence: The agent shows the refused report to the owner and stops the run when the report ends with refused.
findings.fix: Split the start-refusal case by the SKILL.md rows: no_trunk retries after one fetch, no_remote and a repeated no_trunk are ledgered, bad_checkpoint retries after the directory exists, and only other refusals stop the run. Assert the branch taken, not the word refused.

findings.evidence: An early stop (a blocking question, §4, or any other stop after the unit flow started) runs the same `state.record-session`
findings.fix: Name the stops that record the session (blocking question, commit_docs skipped, missing engine, empty GOAL_MD) and the stops that do not (missing scripts dir, missing gsd-core, start refusal).
